action.code: const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); let x = rect.left + rect.width * 0.4; let y = rect.top + rect.height * 0.65; canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true})); setTimeout(() => { x = rect.left + rect.width * 0.5; y = rect.top + rect.height * 0.35; canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true})); }, 800);

const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { setTimeout(() => { const x = rect.left + rect.width * (0.45 + Math.random() * 0.2); const y = rect.top + rect.height * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.2); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true})); setTimeout(() => { const dx = rect.left + rect.width * 0.5; const dy = rect.top + rect.height * 0.33; canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: dx, clientY: dy, bubbles: true})); }, 600); }, i * 1400); }
